common.error: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
common.offline: You're offline. Changes need a connection and were not saved.
common.disclaimer: Sukhi helps you follow a routine you have agreed on. It is not a medical service, does not diagnose, and does not monitor emergencies. In an emergency call 112.

landing.tagline: A gentle companion for the routine you and your care team agreed on.
landing.pillar1: Reminders and friendly conversations in English, हिन्दी and मराठी
landing.pillar2: Honest check-ins with photos or notes — and clear about what they can and can't show
landing.pillar3: A garden that grows when you take part, and celebrates every fresh start

login.title: Welcome to Sukhi
login.magicSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
login.toggleSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.

onboarding.title: Let's set things up
onboarding.name: What should we call you?
onboarding.limitations: Limitations we should keep in mind
onboarding.limitationsHint: For example: difficulty with stairs, low vision. Only share what you are comfortable with.
onboarding.careNotesHint: For example: "recently discharged, following my doctor's walking plan". No diagnosis needed.
onboarding.permissionsIntro: You can change these at any time in Settings.
onboarding.consentAi: Allow AI processing of my messages, photos and plan documents to help me (via Anthropic's API)
onboarding.consentWhatsapp: I may connect WhatsApp later for reminders and replies
onboarding.consentVoice: Allow voice notes to be transcribed and replies read aloud (via Sarvam AI)
onboarding.consentFamily: I may invite a family member to see a progress summary (nothing is shared until I invite someone)
onboarding.routineIntro: Pick a starting point. You can edit everything later. These are examples, not prescriptions.
onboarding.skipRoutine: I'll set up my plan myself
onboarding.whatsappLater: WhatsApp is optional and can be connected later in Settings.

templates.walkDesc: A short walk each evening (personal goal).
templates.waterDesc: A glass of water at set times (personal goal).
templates.stretchDesc: Light stretches three times a week (personal goal).
templates.clinicianDesc: Type or upload what your care team gave you, then check each item.

status.no_response_help: We didn't hear back. This isn't counted as missed.

today.title: Today
today.unwellNote: Thank you for telling us. Rest matters. If you feel worse, please contact your doctor or call 112.

action.title: Action details
action.evidenceIntro: A photo or note helps your history. A photo can only show what is visible — it can't prove something was swallowed, eaten or how long it lasted.
action.outcome_supports: Supports the visible part of this action
action.outcome_does_not_support: Doesn't seem to match this action
action.method_model: Described automatically by AI (not a medical judgement)
action.notProbability: This is a description, not a score or proof.
action.selfReportNote: Self-reports and evidence are shown separately.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.empty: Ask about today's plan, tell me how it went, or just say “done”.
chat.transcriptConfirm: Check what I heard, edit if needed, then send.
chat.transcriptUncertain: I'm not fully sure I heard this right — especially names or numbers.
chat.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. You can type instead, or allow the microphone in your browser settings.
chat.micUnsupported: Voice recording isn't supported in this browser. Please type instead.
chat.voiceUnavailable: Voice isn't available right now. Please type.
chat.voiceConsent: Voice is off. You can enable it in Settings.
chat.rateLimited: You're sending messages quickly. Please wait a moment.
chat.whatsappNote: Messages from WhatsApp appear here too.

plan.title: My plan
plan.empty: You don't have a plan yet.
plan.mode: What kind of plan is this?
plan.modeClinician: Instructions from my doctor or care team
plan.modeClinicianHelp: You transcribe them; Sukhi keeps the source and never treats your entry as clinician-verified.
plan.modePersonalHelp: A personal goal. It is not medical advice.
plan.noItems: No actions yet. Add one below or upload a document.
plan.sched_weekly_target: A number of days per week
plan.alternativesHint: Only fill this if your care team gave you alternatives.
plan.confirmHelp: Check this matches your source exactly. Confirming schedules reminders.
plan.editConfirmedWarning: Changing a confirmed action returns it to draft. You'll need to confirm it again before reminders resume.
plan.clinicalEditWarning: This came from your care team. Only change it to match their instructions — ask them before changing timing or frequency.
plan.unresolvedHelp: These fields couldn't be read clearly. Fill them in from your source before confirming. We never guess.
plan.markResolved: I've checked these against the source
plan.uploadHelp: We'll draft items for you to check. Nothing is scheduled until you confirm each one.
plan.extractUnavailable: Automatic reading isn't available right now. You can enter items manually.
plan.extractNoConsent: AI processing is off, so documents aren't read automatically. Enter items manually or enable it in Settings.
plan.extractFailed: We couldn't read this document. Please enter items manually.
plan.injectionWarning: This document contained text that looked like instructions to an AI. It was ignored. Please check every item carefully.

progress.title: Progress
progress.gardenRule: Your garden grows when you check in honestly and when you come back after a break. It never shrinks.
progress.goalHelp: Something small you'll treat yourself to — no money involved in Sukhi.
progress.goalDone: You reached your goal — enjoy it!

settings.title: Settings
settings.waNotConfigured: WhatsApp isn't configured for this Sukhi installation yet. Everything works in the web app.
settings.waPaused: Paused (reply START on WhatsApp to resume)
settings.waLinkIntro: To connect, create a code and send it from your WhatsApp to the Sukhi number. Codes expire in 15 minutes and work once.
settings.waWindowNote: Outside 24 hours after your last message, Sukhi can only send an approved generic notice like “Your Sukhi check-in is ready.”
settings.familyIntro: Share a weekly progress summary with someone you choose. They never see your chat, documents or plan details. You can stop sharing instantly.
settings.familyLink: Send this link to them (expires in 7 days):
settings.familyNoAutoMessages: Sukhi does not send automatic messages to family members.
settings.memoryIntro: Notes from your conversations. Confirm the ones that are right; reject anything wrong. These are not medical instructions.
settings.latency: Reminders are checked about once a minute. WhatsApp replies usually arrive within seconds and at most a couple of minutes.

family.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has been withdrawn.
family.summaryIntro: Shared by them. Shows participation counts only.
family.revoked: Access to this summary has been withdrawn.

demo.banner: Fictional demo — no real AI, WhatsApp, or medical evaluation. Nothing is saved.
demo.title: Try Sukhi
demo.person: Meet Asha (fictional), following a personal walking goal and a sample routine.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Sukhi needs a connection to load your plan and save check-ins.
